India is the world’s second-largest sugar producer, and over 5 crore farmers depend on the sector for their livelihood. Yet despite its importance, the industry is facing fresh challenges. Sugarcane arrears have surged, ethanol growth has slowed, exports have declined, and many experts believe the sector could be turning cyclical once again.
In this video, we deep-dive into India’s sugar industry and analyse:
PART 1: Understanding the Sugar Value Chain
PART 2: Why the Sugar Sector Is Becoming Cyclical Again
PART 3: Can PLA Be the Next Big Opportunity?
